records.deidentified_narrative: on march 5, 2023, i, deputy h. perez was dispatched to splashes carwash located at [roadway], in reference to a major accident that occurred in the parking lot. upon arrival, i made contact with a witness who identified himself as jose rodriguez [date]. he reported seeing a young hispanic male employee wearing a black t-shirt, later identified as ronal alvarez, attempting to move a white chevy camero from the vacuum station. jose rodriguez reported ronal alvarez lost control of the vehicle when he popped the [roadway] forward and crash into the detailing area. the impact caused the middle carport pole to fall and strike an employee in the head as she was detailing another vehicle. jose rodriguez provided me with a sworn statement. i then spoke with ronal alvarez who reported after vacuuming out the white camero, he attempted to move the vehicle to the detailing station. ronal alvarez advised when he released the clutch he lost control of the vehicle and struck the middle carport post. ronal alvarez informed me he does not have a driver`s license and has no experience operating a manual transmission. ronal alvarez provided me with a sworn statement of the events leading up to the major accident. i spoke with the director of operations, dinno salang, who was able to playback the video footage and show me what had happened. after reviewing the video, i learned that the female employee, yeni rodriguez [date], was exiting the vehicle, which she was detailing at the same time the crash occurred. i observed the pole that was impacted by the white camero strike the female in the head and face area. the pole also caused minor damage to the vehicle yeni rodriguez was detailing, a black honda accord. i contacted the vehicle owner, william quintanilla [date], at [phone] and informed him about the incident. i provided him with the crash report number for his insurance. the owner of the white camaro, casey weeks [date], was also on scene and notified. pearland ems arrived and treated yeni rodriguez for a possible broken nose and a severe skull injury. ems transported yeni rodriguez to [medical facility] downtown for further treatment. yeni rodriguez husband was also an employee and notified on scene [medical facility]. splashes carwash director of operations: dinno salang 06/27/1969insurance company: utica national insurance policy #: 005435350phone: (800)598-8422

records.public_safe_text: on march 5, 2023, i, deputy h. perez was dispatched to splashes carwash located at [roadway], in reference to a major accident that occurred in the parking lot. upon arrival, i made contact with a witness who identified himself as jose rodriguez [date]. he reported seeing a young hispanic male employee wearing a black t-shirt, later identified as ronal alvarez, attempting to move a white chevy camero from the vacuum station. jose rodriguez reported ronal alvarez lost control of the vehicle when he popped the [roadway] forward and crash into the detailing area. the impact caused the middle carport pole to fall and strike an employee in the head as she was detailing another vehicle. jose rodriguez provided me with a sworn statement. i then spoke with ronal alvarez who reported after vacuuming out the white camero, he attempted to move the vehicle to the detailing station. ronal alvarez advised when he released the clutch he lost control of the vehicle and struck the middle carport post. ronal alvarez informed me he does not have a driver`s license and has no experience operating a manual transmission. ronal alvarez provided me with a sworn statement of the events leading up to the major accident. i spoke with the director of operations, dinno salang, who was able to playback the video footage and show me what had happened. after reviewing the video, i learned that the female employee, yeni rodriguez [date], was exiting the vehicle, which she was detailing at the same time the crash occurred. i observed the pole that was impacted by the white camero strike the female in the head and face area. the pole also caused minor damage to the vehicle yeni rodriguez was detailing, a black honda accord. i contacted the vehicle owner, william quintanilla [date], at [phone] and informed him about the incident. i provided him with the crash report number for his insurance. the owner of the white camaro, casey weeks [date], was also on scene and notified. pearland ems arrived and treated yeni rodriguez for a possible broken nose and a severe skull injury. ems transported yeni rodriguez to [medical facility] downtown for further treatment. yeni rodriguez husband was also an employee and notified on scene [medical facility]. splashes carwash director of operations: dinno salang 06/27/1969insurance company: utica national insurance policy #: 005435350phone: (800)598-8422
